purpose: One finite historical implementation test of actual dated cash-and-carry and one declared exit-policy counterfactual. Not a365day multi-strategy account or module admission; do not upgrade source preparation to profit proof.
terminal_calendar: Carry the full delivery day through the next UTCmidnight so daily Sharpe includes settlement/spot-unwind cash rather than omitting a terminal8hour stub. This is fixed before new account returns; capacity-limited residual, if any, remains marked at the boundary.
rules: Before-entry original0328listing plus generic quarterly clock; March2025expiry-confirming notice becomes modeled-known only after its claimed publication+5minutes. API midnight deliveryTime is a calendar-key only; actual event at08:00 comes from separate notices. Current original historical article versions are not certified.
opportunity_clock: One fixed January1 00UTC opportunity per asset, using December31 23:55 completed actual spot/trade prices. No retries after missing liquidity or hedge failure, no within-quarter reentry or outcome-selected assets/months.
entry_condition: Past known F/S-1 exceeds1.25times stress four-leg reference roundtrip rate2*(spot10bps+future5bps+2*slip10bps)=87.5bps. This is a conservative eligibility proxy, not locked net cash or a future price forecast. Both profiles have identical entries and target amounts.
sizing: Keep previous carry study total25percent spot and70percent future wallet, no larger risk budget. Cap desired equal net base quantity by1percent preceding actual quote volume in both markets; next-bar fills remain independent. Fractional quantities/trade-close+slippage are disclosed research proxies; historical lot/tick/commission precision and order books are unverified, never claimed as venue executable orders.
cost_scope: Spot10bps and dated taker5bps per side are explicit model assumptions, not actual client/historical fee certification. Fixed settlement fee5bps follows the same modeled taker rate, has no market-fill slippage; early-market exit pays actual modeled slippage. Zero funding only because the contract is fixed-maturity, and nonempty funding input must be rejected.
delivery: At expiry, after checking old inventory margin risk on the preceding actual markOHLC, settle only the remaining dated quantity at the recorded official settlement reference, book q*(entry-settlement)-settlementFee to the futures wallet, and disable that future permanently. Request spot-only unwind at expiry; first eligible ordinary spot fill is next completed5m interval. No old-future fill at/after expiry and no last-close substitution or post-expiry mark ownership.
early_exit: Only declared variant: request both legs at expiry minus24hours, with independent next5m fills and capacity, retaining any failed hedge and forced settlement of actual residual if needed. This is a different holding contract, not a repair making unknown historical terminal cash known.
risk: Reuse segregated spot cash/assets and futures wallet model, conservative actual markOHLC high/spotlow envelope,20percent margin-warning exit and5percent maintenance-stress invalidation, persistent15percent account halt and downward-only gross control. Spot gains are never credited as available future margin. Risk flags invalidate qualification even if final modeled PnL is positive; these envelopes are not verified exchange liquidation/tier reconstruction.
controls: same entries and size, one exit-policy variant
separate spot-price, future-price, settlement, fees, slippage and residual-inventory attribution; do not call differing realized risk matched
minimum_useful_effect_design: Pilot screen requires positive totalANDclosedPnL and netPnL>=25percent of all paid trading friction plus unpaid exit reserve at both costs, DD<=15percent and no risk/hedge-failure flags. The25percent operational buffer reuses the existing1.25cost-coverage rationale; it does not establish portfolio-economic usefulness. Report actual USDT and NAV effects. Shared-account contribution still needs later matched allocation controls.
known_sample_limit: Only one common quarter/two correlated asset campaigns. Even if screen-positive, this cannot satisfy registered module cycle/cluster or365day total-account gates. No capacity followup is permitted from this pilot, no annual target comparison or freshOOS claim.
validation: Independent cash/inventory/mark/settlement audit; pre-expiry decisions invariant to future settlement-price perturbation; strict late-source/no-old-future-fill checks; preserve observed nonzero post-expiry archive rows. Actual different-process JSON restoration before expiry and exactly at expiry while spot remains, with exact money/ledger/state and independently bounded exposure if floating summation differs.
stopping: Seal all results and contradictions. No threshold, entry hour, expiry clock, wallet split or risk-scale search after seeing PnL. Technical failures retain original source/output and require explicit versioned repair, not selective reruns.
technical_repair: Preserve v001 failed input validation; accept equivalent English ten minutes. Account economics, assets, costs, clocks, risks and comparisons unchanged.
